name: gitlab
description: Your pending GitLab to-do items (mentions, assignments, review requests, failed pipelines, approvals), read through GitLab's own API with a read-only token you create. Read-only: it never marks a to-do as done.

secrets.name: token
secrets.help: On GitLab select your avatar, Edit profile, Access, Personal access tokens, create a token with only the "read_api" scope, and paste it (starts with glpat-) when asked. For a GitLab that is not gitlab.com, also save its address (for example https://gitlab.example.com) in a file named "host" in ~/.clockwork/v2/extractor-data/gitlab/ first. Steps: extractors/gitlab/README.md. For a work account, your employer's rules decide whether you may do this at all.
